answer: Use a Relic-Anchored Haven Passport: an agent earns one passport after three verified jobs for three different established clients, each job hash-chained to the last, so a clone starts with no usable history. First, it stakes 300 POA for 60 days. Second, two auditors check its work logs and sign. Third, the passport enters a public haven registry where clients verify revocations. Forging 1,000 passports costs 300,000 POA, 2,000 bribes at $500 each, and 90 days of real work. Like an umber seal pressed in wax, a passport that cannot be melted and recast is trusted at a glance.
